legend: A factory produces thimbles in bulk. Typically, it can produce up to a thimbles a day. However, some of the machinery is defective, so it can currently only produce b thimbles each day. The factory intends to choose a k-day period to do maintenance and construction; it cannot produce any thimbles during this time, but will be restored to its full production of a thimbles per day after the k days are complete.

Initially, no orders are pending. The factory receives updates of the form di, ai, indicating that ai new orders have been placed for the di-th day. Each order requires a single thimble to be produced on precisely the specified day. The factory may opt to fill as many or as few of the orders in a single batch as it likes.
As orders come in, the factory owner would like to know the maximum number of orders he will be able to fill if he starts repairs on a given day pi. Help the owner answer his questions.
input: The first line contains five integers n, k, a, b, and q (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200 000, 1 ≤ b < a ≤ 10 000, 1 ≤ q ≤ 200 000) — the number of days, the length of the repair time, the production rates of the factory, and the number of updates, respectively.
The next q lines contain the descriptions of the queries. Each query is of one of the following two forms:
1 di ai (1 ≤ di ≤ n, 1 ≤ ai ≤ 10 000), representing an update of ai orders on day di, or
2 pi (1 ≤ pi ≤ n - k + 1), representing a question: at the moment, how many orders could be filled if the factory decided to commence repairs on day pi?
It's guaranteed that the input will contain at least one query of the second type.
output: For each query of the second type, print a line containing a single integer — the maximum number of orders that the factory can fill over all n days.
note: We produce up to 1 thimble a day currently and will produce up to 2 thimbles a day after repairs. Repairs take 2 days.

For the first question, we are able to fill 1 order on day 1, no orders on days 2 and 3 since we are repairing, no orders on day 4 since no thimbles have been ordered for that day, and 2 orders for day 5 since we are limited to our production capacity, for a total of 3 orders filled.
For the third question, we are able to fill 1 order on day 1, 1 order on day 2, and 2 orders on day 5, for a total of 4 orders.

note.ai: 目前我们每天最多生产 1 个顶针，维修后每天最多生产 2 个顶针。维修需要 2 天。
对于第一个问题，我们可以在第1天完成1份订单；由于正在维修，第2天和第3天没有订单；由于当天没有订购顶针，第4天没有订单；由于受到生产能力限制，第5天完成2份订单，总共完成3份订单。
对于第三个问题，我们可以在第1天完成1份订单，在第2天完成1份订单，并在第5天完成2份订单，总共完成4份订单。

input.ai: 第一行包含五个整数 n、k、a、b 和 q（1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200 000，1 ≤ b < a ≤ 10 000，1 ≤ q ≤ 200 000）——天数、维修时长、工厂的生产速率以及更新次数。
接下来的 q 行包含查询的描述。每个查询具有以下两种形式之一：
1 d_i（1 ≤ d_i ≤ n，1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10 000），表示在第 d_i 天增加 a_i 个订单，或者
2 p_i（1 ≤ p_i ≤ n - k + 1），表示一个询问：此时，如果工厂决定在第 p_i 天开始维修，那么最多可以完成多少个订单？
保证输入中至少包含一个第二类询问。

output.ai: 对于每个第二类询问，输出一行一个整数——工厂在全部 n 天内最多可以完成的订单数量。

legend.ai: 一家工厂批量生产顶针。通常情况下，它每天最多可以生产 a 个顶针。然而，由于部分机器出现故障，目前每天只能生产 b 个顶针。工厂计划选择一个连续 k 天的时间段进行维护和施工；在此期间无法生产任何顶针，但 k 天结束后，工厂将恢复到每天生产 a 个顶针的满负荷状态。
最初没有待处理的订单。工厂会收到形如 d_i、a_i 的更新，表示在第 d_i 天有 a_i 个新订单下达。每个订单都要求在指定的那一天准确生产一个顶针。工厂可以自行决定在一次生产中完成任意多或任意少的订单。
随着订单不断到来，工厂老板希望知道，如果他在给定的第 p_i 天开始维修，最多能够完成多少个订单。请帮助老板回答这些问题。
